caption: The six worked-example tasks split two per learning type. Notice tasks 1 and 4: both have labels, but house price is a number (regression) and spam is a class (classification).

spec.title: Worked example: 6 tasks, 2 per type
spec.aria: Six worked-example tasks split into three groups of two: supervised learning gets tasks 1 and 4, unsupervised learning gets tasks 2 and 5, and reinforcement learning gets tasks 3 and 6.
